note: {tally}. A minus B is a difference in percentage points with its 95% interval, clustered by paused step (by task for fresh episodes, whole runs and first calls). Above 0, below 0 and excludes 0 are conditions on that interval (above 0 where a row gives none); the number in parentheses is the pre-registration. Unless a row names another outcome, it is that the next call reads a neighbor's code (first four groups), that the agent is shown a line the fix changes (fifth and sixth) or that the first call goes to a graph tool (last). In pre-registrations 15 and 17, C is note minus own result on the share of reads of a hit file that ask past line 1, and R the ratio of the note's gain to the own result's gain; the note carries the line number about as well if R is at least two thirds. Not tested: bare names were not followed, which the rule asks for first. Underpowered: with the instruction the true entry was read in {b2_rate}% of replays where the rule asks for 5%. The rule marked "see note" is not met under a wider recount, in which a second scorer also credits a recursive search of a directory that holds the neighbor's file ({b1_wide} [{b1_wide_lo}, {b1_wide_hi}]). Rows in grey are not counted: the rewired-list rule and the rule on the parts of an address are counted once each, and the row that begins with Gate is a gate. The other gates and the full wordings are in Appendix A.
